subject: Next briefing and availability — BlueArc Systems (post-discovery)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@bluearc.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.k@bluearc.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next briefing and availability — BlueArc Systems (post-discovery)

Hi Tom / Aisha —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap (short):
- BlueArc is evaluating inference options for low-latency document processing (50–200ms target) and wants predictable unit cost for high throughput batch jobs.
- Primary success criteria: latency SLOs, data isolation, and integration with current S3 + KMS workflows.
- Likely technical owners: Aisha (platform) and a downstream ML owner (TBD).

Suggested next step: 30-minute product briefing/technical walkthrough where we can: 
- Walk through the runtime and KV cache behavior at 1–2k concurrent streams
- Discuss quantization and batching trade-offs for BlueArc workloads
- Surface deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and SLA implications

Proposed 30-minute windows (pick one):
- Option A: Wed Apr 21, 10:00–10:30 AM PT / 1:00–1:30 PM ET
- Option B: Thu Apr 22, 2:00–2:30 PM PT / 5:00–5:30 PM ET
- Option C: Mon Apr 26, 9:00–9:30 AM PT / 12:00–12:30 PM ET

Who should join from your side? Please include the platform owner and anyone who'll sign off on security or procurement so we can tailor the brief. From our side: Karthik (technical lead) will run the walkthrough; Jordan will be on the call to cover commercial/next-steps and procurement questions.

Attachments: BlueArc-Discovery-Notes.pdf (summary of today's call) and Quick-Agenda-v2.md (draft 20–30 min agenda).

Calendar link: https://calendly.com/redwood/bluearc-30min — feel free to pick a time directly if that's easiest.

If none of these windows work, tell me a couple of 30-minute blocks that do and we'll accommodate.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: BlueArc-Discovery-Notes.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: Quick-Agenda-v2.md (markdown)]

Subject: Re: Next briefing and availability — BlueArc Systems (post-discovery)

Marcus —

Appreciate the recap and the clear next steps. Option B (Thu Apr 22 at 2pm PT) looks best for our team — Aisha can make that time, and I'll confirm with our ML lead (likely joining as well).

Two quick asks before the briefing:
- Can you share a short note on expected token/unit cost for a typical batch + streaming mixed workload (ballpark is fine)? That'll help our procurement/finance folks decide who needs to be on the call.
- If possible, please add a line item in the agenda for integration patterns with S3/KMS.

I'll loop in anyone else after checking availability; for now, please hold Option B.

Tom
Tom Bennett
Director of Engineering | BlueArc Systems
Tom.Bennett@bluearc.com
+1 (617) 555-0124

Date: Thu, 14 Apr 2026 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next briefing and availability — BlueArc Systems (post-discovery)

Tom —

Thanks — Option B (Thu Apr 22, 2:00 PM PT) is saved on our side. I've updated the Quick-Agenda-v2.md to include a short line on S3/KMS integration and a high-level cost ballpark for mixed batch/streaming workloads (see bullet below).

Ballpark unit economics (indicative):
- Hosted small-to-medium instance: ~$0.015–0.03 per 1k tokens (depends on batching + sequence distribution)
- Dedicated/Private (committed): lower per-unit with predictable monthly commit; we'll cover specifics in the commercial section

Karthik will lead the technical walkthrough and will plan to cover quantization/latency tradeoffs and recommended batching strategies for BlueArc's profile. Jordan will handle procurement/next-steps and will follow up after the session with pricing options and a mutual action plan draft.

Please accept the invite from Calendly (I will also send a calendar hold). If anything changes, I'm available to shift — otherwise we'll plan for Thu Apr 22 at 2pm PT.

Cheers,
Marcus

Marcus / Tom / Aisha —

I'll be on Thu at 2pm PT and will focus the demo on three items:
- KV cache behavior under mixed batch + streaming loads (brief bench numbers + what to expect)
- Quantization and batching tradeoffs (practical knobs we recommend for 8-bit/4-bit paths)
- Integration patterns for S3/KMS (how to keep keys customer-managed + audit log surface)

I'll bring a short slide with sample latency numbers and a simple checklist for private deployment requirements. Jordan — flag me if you want a quick pre-brief sync before Thu.

Thanks,
